title: CPA Workpaper Spec - Common Definitions
description: Shared building-block definitions reused across the CPA Workpaper Spec entity schemas (v0.1). This file is not itself a document schema; it only provides reusable $defs referenced via $ref.

specVersion.description: Semantic version of the CPA Workpaper Spec this document conforms to.

id.description: Opaque, system-assigned identifier for an entity. The spec does not mandate a format (UUID, ULID, slug, and integer-as-string are all valid).

isoDate.description: Calendar date with no time component (RFC 3339 full-date).

money.description: A monetary amount. Stored as a decimal string to avoid float rounding, plus an ISO 4217 currency.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, e.g. "1250.00". May be negative.

personRef.description: A lightweight reference to a person (staff member or client contact). Identity systems are out of scope for this spec; only a stable id and a display name are modeled.

serviceTrack.description: The category of professional service an engagement covers. Firm-agnostic vocabulary.

fiscalPeriod.description: A bounded reporting period (a month, quarter, or year) identified by start and end dates.

attachmentRef.description: A reference to a supporting document. The spec models the reference, not the bytes; storage and transport are implementation concerns.

uri.description: Optional resolvable location for the attachment.

note.description: A free-text annotation with optional authorship and timestamp.
